findings.current: You could survive the fight, only to die when your wounds got worse.
findings.defect: This ties the worsening wounds specifically to surviving a fight. The Korean says that even after barely surviving, someone might die when their wounds worsen; it does not specify that those wounds came from a fight.
findings.rationale: The Korean separates dying in a fight from barely surviving and later dying as wounds worsen, without establishing that the latter follows from the fight.
findings.replacement: Even if you barely survived, your wounds could worsen and kill you.

findings.current: lunatics made up a good share of them
findings.defect: This weakens the source’s image of Murim being teeming with lunatics to merely having a notable proportion of them.
findings.rationale: The Korean 득실거렸다 conveys abundance—people swarming or teeming—while 대체로 characterizes them broadly as lunatics.

summary: The chapter is largely faithful, with two minor shifts in emphasis and causality.
